links.comparator_used: Direct prompting of the same frozen local Llama 3.1 8B model
links.outcome: Correctness of clinical calculator answers (all-record benchmark correctness and correct answers on eligible case reports)
links.effect: Benchmark: 631/1,043 (60.5%) for CIBB-Guard vs 101/1,043 (9.7%) for direct prompting. Eligible case reports: 4 correct of 44 vs 0 with direct prompting.
links.tradeoff: On 33 ineligible cases, CIBB-Guard accepted 12 inappropriate answers, and 11 of those 12 passed genuine alternate-representation re-verification. Its internal consistency check therefore does not establish that the selected calculator fits the case. It correctly declined 21 of the 33.
links.quote: On the benchmark, all-record correctness was 631/1,043 (60.5%) for CIBB-Guard and 101/1,043 (9.7%) for direct prompting; all accepted confirmatory answers were synthetic.

design_hint: guarded pipeline with alternate-representation verification and calculator applicability check
